cbomkit-csharp-parser ${cbomkit.csharp.parser.version}

  A pre-built ANTLR lexer and parser for C#, used by the C# detection rules.
  Maven coordinate: io.github.fynnth:cbomkit-csharp-parser:${cbomkit.csharp.parser.version}
  Project: https://github.com/fynnth/cbomkit-csharp-parser

  The parser is made available under the Eclipse Public License 2.0
  (EPL-2.0); the licence text is in META-INF/third-party/EPL-2.0.txt. This JAR
  contains it in object code form only, combined with the plugin by the Maven
  Shade plugin; it is not modified.

  Source code: the parser's source code is available from
    https://github.com/fynnth/cbomkit-csharp-parser
  and as the sources JAR published on Maven Central:
    https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/fynnth/cbomkit-csharp-parser/${cbomkit.csharp.parser.version}/cbomkit-csharp-parser-${cbomkit.csharp.parser.version}-sources.jar

  Any provisions in the EPL-2.0 that differ from the licence of this plugin are
  offered by the parser's contributors alone, not by the other contributors to
  this plugin.
